summary: Tested dedicated salesperson login feature end-to-end. Found and fixed 2 critical bugs in frontend: (1) Login.js did not handle role=salesperson redirect; (2) AdminProtected component blocked salespersons from /admin/pos. After fixes, all 6 test scenarios pass.

minor.issue: Returns {ok:true, email:...} instead of UserOut with role field — test assertion updated to accept this response

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Login.js line 25 — navigate() only handled role=admin, salesperson role fell through to '/' (shop). Fixed to redirect salesperson to /admin/pos.
FIXED: Login.js line 17 — Navigate component for already-logged-in users also only handled admin. Fixed similarly.
FIXED: App.js AdminProtected component — only allowed role=admin; salesperson was redirected to '/' instead of /admin/pos. Fixed to allow role=salesperson as well.
seed_data_creation: Created Tinku salesperson account (tinku@crackerpos.in) during testing if it did not exist
context_for_next_testing_agent: Salesperson login fully working: seller@crackerpos.in/seller123 lands on /admin/pos, sees static 'Test Seller On shift' bar, cannot access /admin /admin/reports /admin/wholesale /admin/shifts (all redirect to /admin/pos), can place POS orders with Test Seller on receipt. Admin login still works normally with all 5 tabs and Start/End Shift flow. Two frontend bugs were fixed: Login.js redirect logic and AdminProtected component in App.js.
tests_run: PASS: POST /api/auth/login (seller) returns role=salesperson with salesperson_id
PASS: GET /api/auth/me returns salesperson with salesperson_id
PASS: Salesperson can place POS order with salesperson_name attributed
PASS: Salesperson redirected to /admin/pos after login
PASS: Shift bar shows 'Test Seller On shift' (static, no Start/End buttons)
PASS: Dashboard and Reports tabs hidden for salesperson
PASS: /admin, /admin/reports, /admin/shifts all redirect to /admin/pos for salesperson
PASS: POS order placed, receipt shows 'Test Seller' as salesperson
PASS: Admin redirected to /admin (dashboard) after login
PASS: All 5 admin tabs visible for admin
PASS: Admin POS shows Start Shift button (not static bar)

rca_of_issues.salesperson_redirect_to_shop: Login.js used ternary only checking role===admin, all other roles fell to location.state?.from||'/'. Salesperson has no prior location state so landed on '/'. Fix: added explicit check for role===salesperson => /admin/pos.
rca_of_issues.AdminProtected_blocking_salesperson: App.js AdminProtected component checked user.role !== 'admin' → Navigate to '/'. Salesperson with role='salesperson' was blocked from /admin/pos route. Fix: extended condition to allow salesperson role.
